hint.text: Computer bugs are not actually real insects!

Lots of big beetles living inside a computer.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to answer Freddie’s questions.

atoms.b: I still don’t quite understand what a computer ((++bug horse)) is. Can you explain?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>I still don’t quite understand what a computer bug is. Can you explain</prosody>

atoms.b: Of course! A computer bug is a mistake in the instructions of a computer program. This causes the program to go ((++wrong right)).
It’s just like when you’re writing a story! You might make a ((++spelling peeling)) mistake or forget to add some important punctuation.
Okay... but why does a simple mistake cause a ((++problem flood))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Okay... but why does a simple mistake cause a problem?</prosody>

atoms.b: Computers just follow the ((++instructions recipe)) they are given step by step. So, if the program has a bug, the computer cannot complete it.
